diagnosis: The decentralized storage deal explorer returns file manifests, piece CIDs, and escrow parameters for any dealId given in the route parameter. The handler performs no check to ensure that deal.owner_account_id corresponds to req.user.accountId. While the underlying files are on decentralized storage, private client metadata and dataset hierarchy manifests are exposed.
